owner: Hypercurve polynomial/line incidence, retained generated chord parameters and selected point evidence
domain: Admitted polynomial graph branches versus Curve2::try_line carriers, first with represented native endpoints and then with retained polynomial-fiber endpoints. Exact native LineSeg2 counterparts are controls. The original endpoint definitions and line parameter correspondence remain authoritative.
missing_witness: Generated vertical line contacts and selected common-line overlaps must complete through both public intersection APIs, retain both source parameters, and permit split/requery without independent coordinate materialization as a prerequisite.
planned_regressions: Same rational endpoints through native LineSeg2 and generated Curve2::try_line.
Vertical chord connecting selected y=+-sqrt(2) polynomial points, intersected with the original quintic branch.
Common selected y=-sqrt(2) line component with endpoints retained from the original polynomial branch.
resource_contract: Initial direct executable probes have 300-second external containment; a timeout is not typed kernel exhaustion. Counted budgets and replay/certainty guards follow any implementation proposal.
status: All three exact native controls pass; each equivalent generated-line public query reproduces Intersection/ImplicitPolynomial/Unsupported on committed fd1313a23. No production changes.

design_review.finite_contact_path: Reuse the existing selected chord support proof and polynomial line-section authority, then retain a chord-owned point parameter through parameter_at_certified_point. The chord owns finite containment; a canonical support line must never replace its finite domain.
design_review.overlap_path: An exact correspondence must transport branch source abscissas to chord point parameters and back, and use clip_corresponding_parameter_ranges for repeated clipping. Matching endpoint positions alone does not prove line support.
design_review.unmaterialized_constant_support: A polynomial independent of x has constant-y selected graph branches of arbitrary finite degree. This proves a straight support without extracting a Real y coordinate; any chord overlap still requires exact equality to that selected y and finite parameter maps.
design_review.lower_layer_guard: A PolynomialPoint coordinate already stored as a native exact source parameter can supply a canonical axis support without new projection. Unknown and exhausted predicates must remain distinct; do not swallow an exhausted optional support attempt.
design_review.scope_warning: General oblique chords with unrelated selected endpoints need coefficient/field/system algorithms. Neither a represented-endpoint adapter nor a constant-y recognizer establishes general generated-line closure.
